# zone Provider

Manages DNS, domains and webhosting at [zone.eu](https://www.zone.eu) through the ZoneID API v2.

Credentials are an API token generated under ZoneID account management, paired with the ZoneID username it belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    zone = {
      source  = "AlphaTurn/zone"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from ZONE_USERNAME and ZONE_API_TOKEN when not set here.
# Prefer the environment: a token written into configuration ends up in version
# control and in state.
provider "zone" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) ZoneID API token, generated under account management. May also be supplied with the `ZONE_API_TOKEN` environment variable, which is the better place for it: a token in configuration ends up in version control and in state.
- `base_url` (String) API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.zone.eu/v2`. Mainly useful for pointing tests at a stub server.
- `max_retries` (Number) How many times to retry a rate-limited, conflicted or failed request. Defaults to `3`.
- `rate_limit` (Number) Sustained request rate in requests per minute. Defaults to `55`. zone.eu enforces 60 per minute per IP, and the default leaves headroom for retries and for anything else calling the API from the same address. Raising it past 60 will cause throttling, not speed.
- `username` (String) ZoneID username. May also be supplied with the `ZONE_USERNAME` environment variable.
